headline: Last session: Markets closed for weekend; APL Apollo announces ₹28,000 crore deal with Tata Steel

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Wednesday, 25 November.

why: Indian equity markets are closed today on account of the weekend.
APL Apollo Tubes agreed to acquire Tata Steel's tubes and colors business for ₹28,000 crore.
Punjab National Bank clarified that its expected credit loss provision of ₹5,000 crore will not hurt profitability.
Shree Cement outlined a growth strategy targeting over 100 Mt capacity in 3 to 4 years.
whatHappening: APL Apollo Tubes announced a ₹28,000 crore transaction to buy Tata Steel's tubes and colors business units.
PNB's MD stated that ECL provision requirements are around ₹5,000 crore with zero impact on overall profitability.
Shree Cement Chairman Hari Mohan Bangur announced plans for 9-10% growth to cross 100 Mt capacity in 3-4 years.
FSSAI initiated prosecution against Bisleri after finding a packaged drinking water sample to be unsafe.
summary: The Indian stock market remains closed for the weekend. Major corporate updates include APL Apollo acquiring Tata Steel's tubes business for ₹28,000 crore. Additionally, PNB addressed ECL provisions while Shree Cement announced long-term capacity targets.
